About RV International

RV Organica is an India-based manufacturer and supplier of essential oils, carrier oils, aromatherapy oils, fragrance oils, and herbal formulations. We specialize in bulk supply, OEM manufacturing, and private label solutions for cosmetic, hair care, wellness, and personal care brands. RV Organica is the brand name of RV International, an India-based manufacturing company specializing in essential oils, cosmetic ingredients, and private label solutions for brands.
